description.value: District Noodle House is a South Vancouver Vietnamese restaurant founded by two friends, Jennifer and Donna, after years of pandemic-related delays pushed their opening back to 2021. The kitchen focuses on hand-crafted, time-intensive dishes — including pho broths simmered for over eight hours and hand-rolled spring rolls — served in a sit-down setting that also supports delivery via multiple platforms. The restaurant has earned recognition among Vancouver's top restaurants and maintains a dedicated vegan menu section.
